cues.zh: 这里是德国的鲁尔山谷。
cues.en: - This is the Ruhr Valley in Germany.

cues.zh: 它曾经是一个矿区。
cues.en: And it used to be a mining region.

cues.zh: 它曾经出产大量的无烟煤，
cues.en: It used to produce huge amounts of anthracite,

cues.zh: 就是那种得挖很深很深的矿井才能采到的煤。
cues.en: the sort of coal that you have to dig deep, deep tunnels to reach.

cues.zh: 有时要挖到地下超过一公里深。
cues.en: Sometimes more than a kilometre down into the ground.

cues.zh: 但这里最后一座深煤矿在2018年底关闭了，
cues.en: But the last deep coal mine here closed at the end of 2018

cues.zh: 因为世界正稳步转向可再生能源。
cues.en: as the world steadily shifts to renewables.

cues.zh: 但你从这片地貌中，从这样的地方，仍能看到采矿留下的痕迹。
cues.en: But you can see the legacy of that mining in the landscape, in places like this.

cues.zh: 这些奇怪的小山其实是旧的矸石堆。
cues.en: Strange hills which are old spoil tips.

cues.zh: 是挖出来的一切非煤物质的堆放场。
cues.en: Dumping sites for everything that was dug up, that wasn't coal.

cues.zh: 所有为了开凿矿井而移走的泥土和岩石。
cues.en: All the earth and rock that was moved out of the way to create the mine shafts.

cues.zh: 它们正被逐步复垦。到处都种上了树。
cues.en: They're steadily being reclaimed. Trees have been planted all over.

cues.zh: 其中几座山顶现在还有这样的艺术品。
cues.en: And several of them now have art like this at the top.

cues.zh: 我昨天参观了一件叫 Tetrahedron 的艺术作品。
cues.en: I visited one art piece called the Tetrahedron yesterday.

cues.zh: 天气很差，还有雾。
cues.en: The weather was bad and there was fog.

cues.zh: 说实话，感觉就像置身于
cues.en: And honestly it felt like I was on

cues.zh: 科幻剧里的某种外星星球。
cues.en: some sort of alien planet from a sci-fi show.

cues.zh: 我站着的这座山上还有一个露天剧场，
cues.en: The hill I'm standing on has an amphitheatre as well,

cues.zh: 虽然现在已经有点破败了。
cues.en: although it's a little rundown now.

cues.zh: 在镜头里真的很难传达出这些东西的庞大规模，
cues.en: It is very, very difficult to get across the sheer scale of these on camera,

cues.zh: 几十年间搬运的土石方量惊人。
cues.en: the incredible volume of earth and rock that was moved over decades.

cues.zh: 别误会，鲁尔谷仍然是工业区。
cues.en: Don't get me wrong, the Ruhr Valley is still industrial.

cues.zh: 还有露天煤矿
cues.en: There are still opencast coal mines

cues.zh: 和制造各种东西的工厂。
cues.en: and factories producing all sorts of things.

cues.zh: 但似乎越来越多人在谈论这里工业的遗产
cues.en: But it does seem like there's more and more talk about the legacy of industry here

cues.zh: 而不是工业本身。
cues.en: than actual industry itself.

cues.zh: 一座老煤矿现在成了博物馆和世界遗产。
cues.en: One old coal mine is now a museum and World Heritage Site.

cues.zh: 不过，这里还留有旧煤矿的另一个奇怪后遗症。
cues.en: There's another strange legacy of the old coal mines here, though.

cues.zh: 如果你从地表下挖出那么多物质，再堆到地面上，
cues.en: If you take that much material out from under the surface and put it on top,

cues.zh: 它的质量就开始改变地貌，
cues.en: the mass of it starts changing the landscape

cues.zh: 方式非常不同。
cues.en: in a very different way.

cues.zh: 这个山谷的部分区域不均匀地下沉，有些地方深达20米。
cues.en: Parts of this valley sank unevenly, as far as 20 metres down in places.

cues.zh: 这改变了雨水排放的方式。
cues.en: And that altered the way that rainwater drains.

cues.zh: 具体来说，雨水开始流向人们居住的地方。
cues.en: In that: it starts to drain towards where people live.

cues.zh: 所以昨天，我去参观了一个泵站，
cues.en: So yesterday, I got to visit one of the pumping stations

cues.zh: 它把水送回本该在的地方。
cues.en: that puts the water back where it's supposed to be.

cues.zh: - 问题是，这个地区从1850年起就有煤矿开采。
cues.en: - The problem is that we have coal mining in this area since 1850.

cues.zh: 因此，地貌下沉了。
cues.en: And because of this, the landscape has sunk down.

cues.zh: 所以我们不得不把整条Boye河抽高18米，送入Emscher河。
cues.en: And so we had to pump the whole River Boye up 18 metres to the river Emscher.

cues.zh: 而Emscher河则流向莱茵河。
cues.en: And the river Emscher is flowing to the Rhine.

cues.zh: 在我的管辖区域内，大约有60个泵站，
cues.en: In my operational area, we have about 60 pump stations,

cues.zh: 从只有几百升容量的小站，
cues.en: from a very small station with a few hundred litres,

cues.zh: 到这个每秒4万升的泵站。
cues.en: to this station with 40,000 litres per second.

cues.zh: 这一个站，我们的管辖面积是83平方公里。
cues.en: 83 square kilometres is our operational area, this one station.

cues.zh: 在我的管辖区域内，将近60%会被淹，
cues.en: From my operational area, nearly 60% would be flooded

cues.zh: 如果所有泵站都停止工作的话。
cues.en: if the whole pump stations wouldn't work.

cues.zh: 如果是干燥天气，大概能撑四到五天。
cues.en: If you have dry conditions, it would be four to five days.

cues.zh: 暴雨条件下只有五个小时，水就会涌出来。
cues.en: In heavy rain conditions only five hours. The water will get out.

cues.zh: - 说明一下，这些泵搬运的是一整条河，
cues.en: - Just to be clear, those pumps are moving a whole river,

cues.zh: 一条小河，但确实是一整条河，提升18米
cues.en: a small river, but a whole river, 18 metres up

cues.zh: 通过巨大的地下管道。
cues.en: and through massive underground pipes.

cues.zh: 这样水就能汇入一条更大的河，最终流向大海。
cues.en: So the water can then join a bigger river that does eventually flow to the sea.

cues.zh: 这个山谷里大约有180个泵站，大小不一。
cues.en: There are around 180 pumping stations, large and small, across this valley.

cues.zh: 那座泵站是最大的。
cues.en: That one station is the largest.

cues.zh: 暴雨过后，它每秒能抽排多达4万升水。
cues.en: After a heavy storm, it will move up to 40,000 litres of water every second.

cues.zh: 如果你去看关于这个的文章，
cues.en: If you look at articles about this,

cues.zh: 有时会提到地下水和含水层。
cues.en: they'll sometimes mention groundwater and aquifers.

cues.zh: 但这里的工程师告诉我，那是错的。
cues.en: But the engineers here told me that is wrong.

cues.zh: 这很可能是误译。
cues.en: It is probably a mistranslation.

cues.zh: 这些是处理雨水的雨水排水道。
cues.en: These are storm drains to deal with rainwater.

cues.zh: - 煤矿公司在为此付钱，
cues.en: - The coal mining companies are paying for this

cues.zh: 因为是他们挖的煤。
cues.en: because they had dug the coal.

cues.zh: 也正因如此，地貌下沉了。
cues.en: And because of this, the landscape has sunk down.

cues.zh: 所以他们得为此买单。
cues.en: So they have to pay for.

cues.zh: - 150年前这里开始采煤时，
cues.en: - When coal mining started here 150 years ago,

cues.zh: 没人想过土地会下沉。
cues.en: no one thought about the land sinking.

cues.zh: 而当他们注意到时，大约是在1900年前后，
cues.en: And when they did notice it, which was somewhere around 1900,

cues.zh: 这也没能阻止开采。他们只是建了第一批水泵。
cues.en: it didn't stop the mining. They just built the first pumps.

cues.zh: 那时，煤值得这份钱和这些麻烦。
cues.en: The coal was worth the money and the trouble then.

cues.zh: 但运行水泵是一项永久的成本。
cues.en: But running the pumps is an eternal cost.

cues.zh: 严格来说，可能不算永久。
cues.en: Not technically eternal, I guess.

cues.zh: 但这在100年、1000年甚至10000年内都不会消失。
cues.en: But this won't go away in 100, or 1,000, or 10,000 years.

cues.zh: 除非出现同样剧烈且地质级别的事件来重塑这片土地。
cues.en: Not until something equally dramatic and geological comes along to reshape the land.

cues.zh: 如果人们想住在鲁尔谷，
cues.en: If people want to live in the Ruhr Valley,

cues.zh: 而不是鲁尔沼泽或鲁尔湖，
cues.en: not the Ruhr Swamp or the Ruhr Lake,

cues.zh: 那么水泵就必须运转。
cues.en: then the pumps must run.
